title: Fragment-shader constants placed at the unaligned end of the vertex constants
expect_note: no existing code covers a constant-block offset that breaks the device's placement alignment (D3D12 CBV 256 bytes; here the dynamic offset 272 is not a multiple of minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment); closest is structure.host-layout
expected_finding: the fragment constant block is bound at region + m_vsh->m_size = region + 272, which is not a multiple of the required uniform-buffer offset alignment; the fix rounds the offset up to 512
